assets.purpose: Landing hero — original creator and game illustration
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original hero illustration for a premium creator-marketing web platform, wide landscape composition.
Primary request: A charming polished 3D still life showing global game campaigns coming to life through creators. Center a glossy periwinkle-blue game controller with deep violet buttons, a floating lavender rounded video-play tile, and a small cobalt-blue megaphone. Connect them with one graceful translucent lilac ribbon curling through the scene. A few small four-point stars, pearl spheres and rounded cubes, kept sparse.
Style/medium: high-end soft 3D product illustration, smooth ceramic and translucent acrylic, playful refined editorial art direction, NOT cartoon characters. Tangible rounded edges and lovely soft ambient shadows.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly clean very pale lavender seamless studio background (#f1efff), objects floating above a low lavender circular podium. No rooms, no user interface, no screens with lettering.
Composition: generous breathing room around the sculptural cluster, close-up hero cluster slightly right of center. Landscape 3:2, artwork occupies 70% of frame, all objects fully visible. Cohesive readable silhouette, no busy scatter.
Lighting/mood: bright airy studio, diffused daylight from top left, restrained subtle iridescence, delightful but trustworthy.
Color palette: cornflower blue, indigo, violet, pale lavender, pearly white. Only a tiny soft pink accent if needed. No orange or red.
Text: none. No words, no logo, no watermark, no digits.
Constraints: original artwork, no real gaming product designs or brand trademarks. Clean production-ready bitmap asset.

assets.purpose: Three fictional campaign concept artworks, cropped in CSS
assets.prompt: Create one wide panoramic game-concept artwork in a 3:1 aspect ratio, with three equal-width distinct scene areas flowing softly into each other. Left third: a dreamy indigo and lavender floating fantasy island with a tiny glowing castle, a crescent moon and soft clouds. Middle third: a futuristic cobalt-blue and violet circular esports arena with luminous curved structures, an electric violet sky and no people. Right third: a cozy miniature pastel lavender planet with rounded blue trees, a tiny white cottage and a winding violet path. Beautiful premium soft 3D clay-and-acrylic illustration, cheerful elevated editorial design, entirely original, no logos, no words, no letters, no numbers, no watermarks, no real brands. Three distinct self-contained focal scenes centered at 1/6, 1/2 and 5/6 of the image width so each third can serve as its own game campaign card crop. Generous blue-purple airy backgrounds, soft studio-like light, polished rounded forms, charming but refined, no black outlines. Landscape very wide composition, no borders or panel separators.

assets.purpose: Montage public home hero — original composition edited to Wanted blue
assets.prompt: Preserve the game controller, video tile, megaphone, translucent ribbon, pearl spheres and podium composition. Replace lavender, purple and pink with Wanted electric blue #0066FF, cobalt #0052CC, pale ice blue, silver and white. Deep navy controller buttons. Premium polished 3D illustration, generous breathing room, no text or logos. Transparent background.

assets.purpose: Public home hero — soft mint and muted teal palette
assets.reference: User-provided mint paper-and-pencil illustration, used for palette and material mood only
assets.prompt: Edit Image 1, the existing game marketing hero illustration. Image 2 is a COLOR PALETTE AND MATERIAL MOOD REFERENCE ONLY. Preserve Image 1's composition, object identities, placements, silhouettes, camera angle, proportions and 3:2 landscape canvas: floating game controller at center, play icon upper left, megaphone upper right, looping translucent ribbon, stars, cubes, spheres and round pedestal. Recolor the vivid saturated electric blue plastic to a calm mint, seafoam and muted turquoise palette inspired by Image 2: pale mint highlights, soft aquamarine midtones, deeper teal shadows and accents. Shift dark navy buttons to deep muted teal. Keep white and pearl-silver elements neutral with a slight mint reflection. Soften harsh high-gloss reflections into a refined satin finish while preserving clear three-dimensional depth, delicate glass ribbon transparency, and readable object details. The result should feel airy, quiet and softly lit like the mint paper-and-pencil reference, not neon, not strong cobalt blue. Do not introduce a paper scroll, pencil, new objects, text, lettering, logos, borders or watermarks. Preserve the transparent background and clean alpha edges; keep the existing objects completely in frame.

notes: Original artwork. No real brand partnerships or campaign availability implied. WebP compression only; originals retained by the image generation tool.
